The target's recurring `b<cond> <next+4>` + unconditional `b <exit>` pair (what fndiff --ops reports as `target-only: +1 b +1 bge/ble/bne  ours-only: -1 blt/bgt/beq`) is NOT a peephole artifact and is NOT source-unreachable: our own compiled objects emit the identical shape at 503 sites across 257 objects (census `python tools/gdl/composed_census/nm_branchpair_census.py ours`, run 2026-09-03 at commit ca4074cb1; the retail objects carry 563). What decides the shape is WHAT THE THEN-BLOCK IS. A then-block that leaves the function -- `return;` / `return <value>;` -- is lowered naively as branch-over-one plus an unconditional branch, and is never folded. A then-block that is a `goto <label>` IS folded to a single inverted conditional, and no spelling of the goto escapes it. Measured both directions this run.
